# SCSA Research Lab — Source Code Security Assessment Laboratory

This site presents the verified academic profile, research, publications, collaborators, supervised student projects, and contact details of Dr. Junaid Akram.

## Academic Background

- Assistant Professor at COMSATS University Islamabad, Lahore Campus
- HEC-approved PhD Supervisor
- Postdoctoral research at SnT, University of Luxembourg
- PhD from Tsinghua University

## Research Areas

Dr. Junaid Akram works on source-code security assessment, software vulnerability detection, code clone analysis, Android and cross-architecture malware detection, software testing, automated test-data generation, software evolution, maintenance, and reuse.

## Selected Research Tools and Projects

- Automated Test Data Generation for the ARC System
- Test Smell Detection in the ARC System
- Log-Based Test Case Slicing
- Obfuscated Code Detection in Android Applications
- SQVDT — Source Code Vulnerability Detection
- VCIPR — Function-level Vulnerability Detection
- DroidSD — Android Similarity Detection
- IBFET — Large-scale Code Clone Detection

## Supervision

The FYP Supervision page combines verified supervised projects and internship outcomes from the professor's previous website with current FYP ideas published by the COMSATS Lahore Computer Science department.
